verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no user-configurable recurring schedule. The closest items are adjacent: rule-based auto-categorization, the AI Close month-end process, and a marketing line about tasks 'described once, done automatically'. None of these documents defining a job or workflow that runs on a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
